source: 570 Festival
target: Festum DLXX

source: On Aquina Street, a two-story ceremonial boat crafted from wood, cardboard, and adorned with ribbons rolled forward, propelled by four sleek horses.
target: In via Aquina, navis caerimonialis duplex ex ligno et chartacea confecta, fasciis volventibus ante ornata, a quattuor equitibus nitidis impellitur.

source: This intricate vessel mimicked the Governor of the Sea’s boat, designed to economize materials and size, allowing horses to guide it through the city.
target: Haec intricata navis gubernatoris maris navem imitata est, materiae et amplitudinis parcendo destinata, equos urbe ducere concedens.

source: Eight men and eight women, dressed vibrantly, stood on both upper and lower levels of the flower boat.
target: Octo viri et octo feminae, vestimentis vibrantibus induti, in superiore et inferiore parte navis floralis steterunt.

source: They sang and danced, their joy infecting the spectators on both sides of the street.
target: Cantaverunt et saltaverunt, et eorum laetitia spectatores utrinque viae inebriavit.

source: Port Santa’s premier folk orchestra surrounded the ceremonial boat, playing rhythmic drumbeats and a variety of instruments such as clarinets, oboes, flauta, and strings.
target: Praecipua orchestra popularis Portus Santae navem caerimonialem circuita est, tympanorum rhythmos pulsans atque instrumenta varia, ut clarineta, oboes, flauta atque chordae.

source: The onlookers on the roadside were in high spirits, alternating between singing and following the ceremonial boat, hoping to catch a refreshing spray from the water droplets scattered by the sixteen men and women.
target: Spectatores in margine viae laetitia eximia habebant, inter cantum atque sequendam navem caerimonialem alternantes, sperantes imbrem refrigerantem e guttis aquarum dispersis ab sexdecim viris et feminis capere.

source: Observing the scene from the fifth floor of the Solow Motel, Lumian sensed that the sea prayer ritual had evolved beyond a mere sacrificial ceremony.
target: Ex quinto plano Solow Motel spectans, Lumian sensit ritum maris precationis ultra solam caerimoniam sacrificii evolutum esse.

source: Excluding its core aspects, it had transformed into a city-wide folklore festival.
target: Elementa eius fundamentalia excluens, in festum folkloricum totius urbis versa est.

source: Despite many residents of Port Santa being devout followers of the Earth Mother and not attributing spiritual significance to the sea, they embraced the festivities, dancing and celebrating on this special day.
target: Etsi multi incolae Portus Santae, matrem terrae devote colentes et maris significationem spiritualem negantes, festivitatibus se delectabant, saltantes et celebrantes hac die peculiari.

source: As the flower boat concluded its tour of Aquina Street, Lumian turned to Lugano and remarked,
target: Dum navis floralis per viam Aquina iter perfecit, Lumian ad Lugano conversus dixit:

source: “Take good care of Ludwig today. No matter which celebration you attend, ensure he’s with you.”
target: “Hodie Ludwigum bene curabis. Quamlibet celebrationem frequentes, fac ut ille tecum maneat.”

source: “Yes, Boss,” Lugano replied, influenced by the cheerful atmosphere of the sea prayer ritual, his emotions lifted.
target: “Ita, Domine,” respondit Lugano, in alacritate ritu maris precationis impulsus, affectus levatos.

source: Without wasting any time, Lumian snatched his golden straw hat, exited the suite, and descended the stairs.
target: Nullum tempus amittens, Lumian pileum stramineum aureum arripuit, conclave egressus et scalas descendit.

source: In the lobby, his gaze fell upon Otta Guillaume, the Solow Motel owner, doling out cash to the lady at the front desk and the two attendants—two risot each.
target: In atrio, oculi eius in Otta Guillaume, dominum Solow Motel, incidit, qui pecuniam distribuens mulieri ad mensam principalem et duobus ministris—duos risot singulos—dabat.

source: “Is this a holiday bonus?” Lumian inquired in Intisian.
target: “Estne hoc praemium feriarum?” interrogavit Lumian in lingua Intisiana.

source: “No bonus, just their compensation.”
target: “Nullum praemium, solam mercedem eorum.”

source: “They’re on duty at the motel today, keeping an eye on the place.”
target: “Hodie in officio sunt apud motel, locum vigilantes.”

source: “They’ll miss out on the sea prayer ritual and other celebrations.”
target: “Ritus maris precationis aliaque celebrationes praetermittent.”

source: “I’m heading to the docks to see my little cabbage dance!”
target: “Eo ad moles portus ut parvam brassicam meam saltationem videam!”

source: “I’ll be there too,” Lumian said with a smile, embracing the festive ambiance once again.
target: “Et ego adero,” inquit Lumian cum risu, ambitum festivum iterum amplectens.

source: If the sea prayer ritual lacked mystic elements, Lumian would have fully immersed himself in the festive atmosphere, reminiscent of the few years of Lent he experienced in Cordu.
target: Si ritualis maris precationis elementa mystica deficerent, Lumian se penitus in ambitu festivo submersisset, memor annorum paucorum Quadragesimae quas in Cordu experivit.

source: Exiting the motel, Lumian leisurely strolled towards the harbor, taking note of Port Santa’s residents bedecked in their most glamorous and festive attire.
target: Ex motel egressus, Lumian lente ad portum ambulavit, incolae Portus Santae induti optimis vestimentis fulgurantibus et festivis observans.

source: At a glance, the streets appeared to be awash with a sea of colors.
target: Intuendo, viae apparebant inundatae mari colorum.

source: His attire—a white shirt, black vest, and dark pants—made him stand out like a foreigner amidst the lively crowd.
target: Indumentum eius—camisia alba, lorica nigra, et bracae atratae—eum eminere faciebat ut extraneus inter turbas vivaces.

source: Lumian adorned the golden straw hat, injecting a splash of color into his appearance.
target: Lumian pileum stramineum aureum induit, aspectum suo colore splendidum infundens.

source: The rhythmic chime of bicycle bells accompanied the passing of wooden crate-laden bicycles.
target: Campanae birotarum rhythmatice tintinnabant, comitantes transitum birotarum lignearum sarcinis oneratarum.

source: Vendors energetically peddled popsicles of various flavors to eager citizens anticipating the sea dance and boat race.
target: Venditores alacriter popsiculas variis saporibus ad cives studiosos vendebant, qui saltationem maris et cursum navium exspectabant.

source: Observing the two segments with a relaxed demeanor, Lumian savored the festivities.
target: Observans duas partes cum animi quiete, Lumian festivitatibus fruebatur.

source: He patiently waited until the two-story festival boat, carrying the Governor of the Sea and the Maidens of the Sea, embarked on its journey to Milo Village before departing the port.
target: Patienter exspectavit, donec navis festivalis duplex, gubernatorem maris et puellas maris portans, iter ad Vicum Milo caperet antequam portum relinqueret.

source: Choosing to abstain from other citizen-organized celebrations, Lumian sought refuge in a public washroom within the nearest department store, slipping into a cubicle.
target: Eligens abstinere a ceteris celebrationibus civium ordinatis, Lumian refugium quaesivit in latrina publica intra proximum emporium, se in cellam insinuans.

source: Triggering the black mark on his right shoulder, Lumian materialized in a concealed corner of Milo Village.
target: Signum nigrum in umero dextro excitando, Lumian in angulo occulto Vici Milo apparuit.

source: Shifting into a shadow creature, he seamlessly infiltrated the Oro family’s blend of ancient and modern architecture, arriving at Juan Oro’s bedroom.
target: Se in creaturam umbram vertens, facile infiltravit mixturam architecturae antiquitatis et novae familiae Oro, ad cubiculum Iuan Oro perveniens.

source: The president of the Fisheries Guild awaited Lumian’s arrival, and upon seeing the figure of the adventurer, Louis Berry, emerge from the darkness, Juan Oro, with deep wrinkles, gestured towards the unconscious Milo villagers on the floor.
target: Praeses Gremii Piscandi advenientem Lumiani exspectabat, et, cum Ludovicum Berry, exploratorem, ex obscuritate emergere vidit, Iuan Oro, rugis profundis notis, iners Milenses in pavimento significavit.

source: “These are two of the four deputy hosts for the vigil and the sea sacrificial ritual. Choose one to assume his form.”
target: “Hi sunt duo ex quattuor ministris vicariis pro vigilia et ritu maris sacrificii. Elige unum ut eius formam capiat.”

source: This condition was pivotal for Lumian’s collaboration with Juan Oro. He sought continuous participation in the core sections of the sea prayer ritual.
target: Haec condicio clavis erat ad collaborationem Lumiani cum Iuan Oro; constantem participationem in partibus fondamentis ritus maris precationis optabat.

source: Initially hesitant due to the inability to deceive other sea spawn and introduce a stranger onto the ship, Juan Oro only agreed to allow Lumian to infiltrate the Governor of the Sea’s residence before the vigil ritual, observing it discreetly.
target: Primo dubitans, propter impossibilitatem alios creaturas maris decipere et hospitem in navem introducere, Iuan Oro tantum consensit ut Lumian in domum gubernatoris maris ante ritum vigiliae infiltraret, ea caute observans.

source: However, with Ultraman under suspicion as a key figure in the Fisheries Guild, Lumian seized the opportunity when Juan Oro required cooperation and assistance, showcasing the abilities of the Lie earring.
target: Sed, cum Ultraman sub suspecta esset ut figura clavis in Gremio Piscandi, Lumian occasionem rapuit, cum Iuan Oro cooperationem et auxilium requirebat, virtutes monili "Lie" ostendens.

source: Thus, Lumian devised a plan to disguise himself as a specific deputy host and gain access to the ship.
target: Itaque Lumian consilium excogitavit ut se ut determinatum ministrum vicarium fingeret et navem intraret.

source: After studying one of the deputy hosts for a few moments, Lumian adorned a silver earring.
target: Postquam aliquot momentum unum ex ministris vicariis observavit, Lumian auriculam argenteam induit.

source: He replicated the appearance of the chosen deputy host, seamlessly blending into his guise.
target: Illius ministri vicarii electi imaginem replicavit, perfecte in eius indutum se miscens.

source: In no time, except for his clothing, there was no discernible difference between Lumian and the deputy host.
target: Nullo tempore, excepto vestitu, discrimen inter Lumian et ministrum vicarium non erat.

source: “It’s my turn,” Juan Oro said in a deep Intisian voice.
target: “Meum est,” inquit Iuan Oro voce Intisiana profunda.

source: He decided to take on the guise of another deputy host and personally board the ship to avert any potential mishaps.
target: Constituit ut indutiam alterius ministri vicarii assumeret atque navem ipse conscenderet, ut casus adversos evitarentur.

source: Concerned about Louis Berry’s involvement in the sea sacrifice and wary of lurking enemies employing unknown methods to cause trouble, Juan Oro believed that everything would converge during the sea sacrifice segment.
target: De Ludovico Berry in sacrificio maris implicato sollicitus, atque hostes subdolos ignotas methodos ad molestiendum adhibentes, Iuan Oro putabat omnia in parte sacrificii maris confluere.

source: Boarding the boat covertly would enable him to address unforeseen circumstances in time, delivering a strategic “surprise.”
target: Clandestine navem conscendens, ei licebat ut casus inopinatos tempore opportuno tractaret, insidias stratēgicas afferens.

source: Juan Oro harbored suspicions that Louis Berry might be an accomplice of last year’s saboteurs, his prior actions serving as a ploy to deceive them and allow him to openly disrupt the ritual at a crucial moment.
target: Iuan Oro suspicabatur Ludovicum Berry socium esse sabotorum anni praeteriti, cujus priores actiones ut dolus ad eos decipiendos atque, in momento critico, ritualem aperte interrumpere concederent.

source: Lumian casually tossed the Lie earring to Juan Oro, who proceeded to change into a dark-blue robe embroidered with various sea elements.
target: Lumian leviter monile "Lie" Iuan Oro iacuit, qui in vestem caeruleam obscuram, diversis elementis maris ornatam, se mutavit.

source: Upon donning the silver earring, Juan Oro experienced a remarkable control over every detail of his body.
target: Auriculam argenteam induens, Iuan Oro praeclarum imperium super singula corporis sui sensit.

source: Attempting to adjust the wrinkles on his face, he observed himself becoming ten to twenty years younger in the mirror.
target: Rugas in facie componere conatus, in speculo se decem ad viginti annos iuveniri observavit.

source: Despite his potent and diverse Beyonder powers, the president of the Fisheries Guild couldn’t help but marvel.
target: Quamquam potentes et varias "Beyonder" facultates haberet, praeses Gremii Piscandi non potuit non mirari.

source: “How magical.”
target: “Quam magicum!”

source: After completing his disguise, Lumian pointed at the unconscious deputy host.
target: Consummato dissimulatione, Lumian ad ministrum vicarium iners digito monstravit.

source: “Who’s responsible for keeping an eye on them and preventing their appearance before the sea prayer ritual?”
target: “Quis eorum custodiam gerit et eorum apparitionem ante ritum maris precationis prohibet?”

source: “My wife,” Juan Oro replied, already prepared.
target: “Uxor mea,” inquit Iuan Oro, iam paratus.

source: She, a former Maidens of the Sea and the current Matriarch of the Oro family, possessed considerable strength.
target: Ea, olim puella maris et nunc matriarchae familiae Oro, viribus ingentibus instructa erat.

source: While she hadn’t participated in any ring-making rituals, she was a trusted individual who wouldn’t divulge secrets.
target: Quamvis nullis rituum circulorum conficiendorum particeps fuerit, fidei persona creditissima erat, nec arcana patefaceret.

source: Lumian redirected the conversation, inquiring, “As the president of the Fisheries Guild, won’t you be suspected if you don’t wait for news of the successful sea prayer ritual with the other committee members?”
target: Lumian sermonem redirigens rogavit: “Ut praeses Gremii Piscandi, non suspectus eris si nova de feliciter peracta ritu maris precationis cum ceteris membris commissionis exspectare non velis?”

source: “No, I don’t go every year. I can also wait for news at home, and my wife will pretend to be me,” Juan Oro stated, pointing at Lie on his left ear and removing it.
target: “Non, non ea quoque annuatim. Possum domi nova exspectare, et uxor mea me imitabitur,” inquit Iuan Oro, monile "Lie" ad auriculam sinistram ostendens et tollens.

source: After confirming the details, Lumian inquired further, “Have you investigated any of those who nearly died and came back to life, or have their personalities undergone a significant change?”
target: Confirmatis rebus, Lumian ulterius rogavit: “Investigavisti aliquos qui paene mortui sunt et ad vitam redierunt, aut num personalitates eorum signanter mutatae sint?”

source: These individuals were key members of the Fisheries Guild familiar with the specific design of the Ring of the Sea Queen and the complete details of the sea prayer ritual.
target: Hi erant clāvi membri Gremii Piscandi, qui noti erant ratione certae Annuli Reginae Maris et totis rebus ritus maris precationis.

source: According to Franca, every member of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society was a soul from another world, having “resurrected” in recently deceased human bodies. This information could help identify who might be Ultraman.
target: Secundum Francam, omnis membrum Societatis Investigationis Simiae Crispatae anima ex alio mundo erat, in nuper defunctis corporibus humanis “resurrecta.” Haec notitia ad cognoscendum qui Ultraman esse possit, utilis esse potest.

source: Juan Oro slowly shook his head.
target: Iuan Oro lente caput concussit.

source: “No, at least not in my memory. Time was tight, so I couldn’t investigate them one by one.”
target: “Non, saltem non memoravi. Tempus arctum fuit, itaque eos singulis investigare non potui.”

source: The rejuvenated elder, now appearing in his prime, continued, “Remember, your name is Brian now. My name is Jorge. If you don’t understand what others are saying later, it’s fine. I’ll hint at you. When you need to answer questions, I’ll help you.”
target: Senex rejuvenescentis, nunc in optima forma apparens, continuavit: “Memento, nunc nomen tuum Brian est. Mihi Jorge nomen est. Si postea verba aliorum non intellegas, nihil est; tibi insinuabo. Cum quaestionibus respondere oportet, te adiuvabo.”

source: “Alright.” Lumian maintained the pretense of not knowing Highlander.
target: “Recte,” inquit Lumian, simulans se Highlander nescire.

source: In reality, having extensively studied under the effects of the Language Comprehension charm, he had already mastered more words and grammar.
target: Revera, effectibus incantationis Comprehensionis Linguae multum studens, iam multa verba et grammaticam didicerat.

source: While still unable to fully comprehend others’ words, he could grasp key words, tense, and the active and passive voice, allowing him to roughly understand the meaning.
target: Etsi non omnia verba aliorum plene comprehendere poterat, vocabula clavia, tempora, atque vocem activam et passivam capere valebat, quo sensum approximatum intellegere licebat.

source: Expressing himself with short sentences and simple structures presented no challenge.
target: Sibi exprimere per breves sententias et simplices structuras nullum difficultatem praebebat.

source: Clad in the dark-blue robe of a deputy host, Lumian entered the Governor of the Sea’s residence, guided by Juan Oro, who no longer staggered.
target: Indutus in veste caerulea obscura ministri vicarii, Lumian in domum gubernatoris maris intravit, ductus a Iuan Oro, qui non iam titubabat.

source: Passing through a hall adorned with sea creature statues, they reached the room where the Governor of the Sea maintained his vigil.
target: Per atrium statuis creaturarum maris ornato transeuntes, ad conclave pervenerunt, ubi gubernator maris vigiliam tenebat.

source: The current Governor of the Sea, Simon of the Guiaro family, was from a branch with a thin bloodline, unqualified to reside in the ancestral house.
target: Gubernator maris nunc vigens, Simon ex familia Guiaro, ex stirpe tenui sanguinis, idoneus non erat in domo maiorum manere.

source: At that moment, Simon sat cross-legged on the cold floor, suppressing his excitement.
target: Illo momento, Simon in pavimento frigido sedebat, cruribus contrahentibus, excitamentum suum reprimentem.

source: With half-closed eyes, he felt the moist air enveloping him.
target: Oculis semi clausis, sentiebat aerem humidum eum amplecti.

source: Although Lumian refrained from activating his Spirit Vision, he sensed various sea spawn bustling in the shadows, the void, and the statues.
target: Quamquam Lumian Visionem Spirituum non excitavit, diversas creaturas maris in umbris, in vacuo, et in statuis agitando sentiebat.

source: Juan Oro led Lumian out of the room, guiding him to the most secluded part of the building.
target: Iuan Oro Lumian e conclavi duxit, eum ad remotissimam partem aedificii ducens.

source: Opening the wooden door to the servants’ quarters, Juan Oro addressed the fake Governor of the Sea, Miguel, lying on the bed.
target: Aperiens ostium ligneum ad cubicula servis, Iuan Oro gubernatorem maris falsum, Miguel, qui in lecto iacebat, allocutus est.

source: “Once the sea prayer ritual succeeds, you can leave, but you must depart Port Santa with the wealth you’ve amassed over the past year.”
target: “Postquam ritu maris precationis feliciter completus erit, discedere potes; sed Portum Santa cum divitiis, quas per annum praeteritum consecutus es, reliquere debes.”

source: Miguel sat up excitedly. “Alright, alright!”
target: Miguel excitatus surrexit. “Recte, recte!”

source: Though their conversation occurred in Highlander, Lumian grasped the essence.
target: Quamquam sermo eorum in Highlander evenit, Lumian essentiam capivit.

source: After this exchange, Juan Oro translated the conversation for Lumian, emphasizing, “You can verify if I’m lying based on Miguel’s expression.”
target: Post hanc colloquium, Iuan Oro Lumiano sermonem interpretatus est, dicens: “Perscrutare potes, si mendax sim, ex vultu Migeli.”

source: Lumian silently pondered, thinking, So what if you’re not lying? What you said might not be done…
target: Lumian silentio meditatus est, cogitans: “Quid refert si non mendaces es? Quod dixisti fortasse non eveniet…”

source: He then returned to the hall, assuming a cross-legged position opposite the other two deputy hosts.
target: Deinde ad atrium rediit, sedens cruribus contractis contraposito duobus ministris vicariis.

source: As time passed, midnight arrived, marking the completion of the Ring of the Sea Queen.
target: Tempus fugit, et media nox advenit, signans completionem Annuli Reginae Maris.

source: One of the deputy hosts retrieved it and guided it to the basement in the dim moonlight.
target: Unus ex ministris vicariis id recepit et ad cellam sub lunari lumine tenuo duxit.

source: The moment had come to pay homage to their ancestors.
target: Tempus maiorum honorandum advenit.

source: Lumian observed the scene in silence and suddenly had a thought.
target: Lumian silentio scenam observavit et subito rem cogitavit.
